description: An oil-style painting of a dark, muted village square with half-timbered and wooden chalet buildings. A man in a flat cap and long dark coat slips a folded paper into a wooden ballot box on a small table. Other men in hats and overcoats crowd around, and two older women in headscarves stand at the right edge, watching. No legible text, no frame visible; the painting runs edge to edge.
